senses.example_zh: 群山將這個小村落與世隔絕。

senses.example: Geographical isolation limits options for economic development.
senses.example_zh: 地理位置的孤立使經濟發展受限。

senses.example: Many old people live at home in isolation, with minimal social contact.
senses.example_zh: 許多老人在家獨居，與外界幾乎毫無聯繫。

senses.example: What is the shortest route to City Hall?
senses.example_zh: 哪一條是通往市府的捷徑？

senses.example: All our bike tours are routed through the beautiful town.
senses.example_zh: 我們安排的單車之旅都會行經這個美麗小鎮。

senses.example: Computer servers route online orders to each web page they should go.
senses.example_zh: 電腦伺服器將線上訂單傳送至目的地網頁。

senses.example: Our only concern is children's welfare.
senses.example_zh: 我們唯一的考量是兒童福祉。

senses.example: Norway has a comprehensive social welfare system.
senses.example_zh: 挪威有完善的社會福利制度。

senses.example: In our city, one quarter of the single mothers are on welfare.
senses.example_zh: 本市四分之一的單親媽媽靠救濟金過活。

senses.example: This channel provides continuous reports of various games.
senses.example_zh: 這個頻道全天候提供各項賽事報導。

senses.zh: 反覆不斷再次發生的（中有間隔）
senses.example: I've had continual problems with this car since I bought it.
senses.example_zh: 自從我買了這部車後，它就狀況不斷。

senses.example: This new car is said to consume less oil.
senses.example_zh: 據說這部新車較省油。

senses.example: On average, an adult consumes one hundred pounds of meat a year.
senses.example_zh: 一個成人平均一年吃掉一百磅的肉。

senses.example: Interviewing students is a very time-consuming task.
senses.example_zh: 面試學生是很耗時的任務。

senses.example: Most consumers look at labels before buying food.
senses.example_zh: 大部分的消費者購買食物前會看一看標籤。

senses.example: I need free voice recognition software.
senses.example_zh: 我需要免費的語音辨識軟體。

senses.example: The scientist has received public recognition for her accomplishments.
senses.example_zh: 這位科學家的成就已受到大眾認可。

senses.example: He made a tremendous amount of money.
senses.example_zh: 他賺了一大筆錢。

senses.example: We have to calculate the cost of the trip.
senses.example_zh: 我們必須算出這趟旅程的花費。

senses.example: Our calculations show that renting a house is cheaper than buying one.
senses.example_zh: 我們的計算顯示租屋比買房便宜。

senses.example: Parents should regulate how much time their kids can use the internet a day.
senses.example_zh: 父母應管控孩子每天上網的時間。

senses.example: People sweat to regulate their body heat.
senses.example_zh: 人們藉由出汗調節體溫。

senses.example: Those who don't obey the traffic regulations will be fined.
senses.example_zh: 不遵守交通規則的人將處以罰金。

senses.example: Hypothalamus is responsible for the regulation of our body temperature.
senses.example_zh: 大腦下視丘負責調節我們的體溫。

senses.example: The factory has purchased some high-tech machinery.
senses.example_zh: 這間工廠買進一些高科技的機器。

senses.example: A molecule of water has one oxygen atom and two hydrogen atoms.
senses.example_zh: 水分子包含一個氧原子與兩個氫原子。

senses.example: The United States dropped an atomic bomb (A-bomb) in Japan.
senses.example_zh: 美國在日本投擲原子彈。

senses.example: My prime concern is to protect my family.
senses.example_zh: 我最關切的事情是保護我的家人。

senses.example: Churchill was the Prime Minister of England.
senses.example_zh: 邱吉爾曾任英國首相。

senses.example: The hotel is in a prime location.
senses.example_zh: 這家飯店地點絕佳。

senses.example: The sit-com was a popular prime time show.
senses.example_zh: 這部情境喜劇曾是熱門的黃金檔節目。

senses.example: The professional player retired in the prime of his career.
senses.example_zh: 那名職業選手在他的全盛時期退休。

senses.example: The chairman dominates the meeting, refusing to let others speak.
senses.example_zh: 這位主席主導會議，不讓別人發言。

senses.example: English is the dominant language on the internet.
senses.example_zh: 英文是網路上的強勢語言。

senses.example: A competitive company won't lose its dominance in the market.
senses.example_zh: 有競爭力的公司不會失去市場優勢。

senses.example: The artist looked at his work with satisfaction.
senses.example_zh: 這位藝術家滿意地看著自己的作品。

senses.example: To interpret a poem, you have to fully understand its meaning.
senses.example_zh: 詮釋一首詩之前必須充分了解它的意義。

senses.example: I don't know how to interpret her behavior.
senses.example_zh: 我不知道如何解釋她的行為。

senses.example: We need someone good in French to interpret for us.
senses.example_zh: 我們需要一位法語好的人來口譯。

senses.example: Patience is a virtue.
senses.example_zh: 耐心是種美德。

senses.example: Is there any virtue in taking an earlier train?
senses.example_zh: 搭早一點的火車有什麼好處嗎？

senses.example: Tired of doing odd jobs, she is looking for permanent work.
senses.example_zh: 她厭倦打零工，正在找固定的工作。

senses.example: There is a distinct improvement in his handwriting.
senses.example_zh: 他的手寫字有明顯的進步。

senses.example: Moths and butterflies are distinct insects though they look alike.
senses.example_zh: 蛾與蝴蝶看來相似，實為截然不同的昆蟲。

senses.example: It is a universal truth that honesty is the best policy.
senses.example_zh: 「誠實為上策」這個道理放諸四海皆準。

senses.example: These stories have universal appeal.
senses.example_zh: 這些故事引起全世界的共鳴。

senses.example: Determination is one of the qualities found in successful people.
senses.example_zh: 「決心」是成功人士的特質之一。

senses.example: The soldiers stayed in the fort, waiting to launch an attack.
senses.example_zh: 士兵們守在堡壘中等待發動攻擊。

senses.example: The poem was translated from German.
senses.example_zh: 這首詩是從德文翻譯而來。

senses.zh: 將 A 翻譯成 B
senses.example: Harry Potter has been translated into over eighty languages.
senses.example_zh: 《哈利波特》已被譯成超過八十種語言。

senses.example: Much of the poem's meaning has been lost in translation.
senses.example_zh: 這首詩的諸多涵義在譯文中流失了。

senses.example: He works as a translator at the embassy.
senses.example_zh: 他擔任大使館的翻譯人員。

senses.example: Cell phone reception is poor here.
senses.example_zh: 這裡手機收訊不良。

senses.example: The angry host gave his guest a cold reception.
senses.example_zh: 這位憤怒的主人冷漠地接待賓客。

senses.example: We threw a reception to welcome the freshmen.
senses.example_zh: 我們辦一場迎新會歡迎大一新生。

senses.example: We hired a receptionist to receive visitors and answer phones.
senses.example_zh: 我們僱用一名接待員接待訪客與接聽電話。

senses.example: It was a genuine painting by Vincent van Gogh.
senses.example_zh: 這幅畫是文森‧梵谷的真跡。

senses.example: That wine distributor stores up various fine and genuine wines.
senses.example_zh: 那位酒商儲備各式純正的上等葡萄酒。

senses.example: I greeted him with a genuine smile.
senses.example_zh: 我以真誠的微笑歡迎他。

senses.example: The woman genuinely believes that her son is innocent.
senses.example_zh: 這位婦人真心相信她兒子是清白的。

senses.example: The deformed frog is an indication of environmental pollution.
senses.example_zh: 畸形蛙是環境汙染的徵候。

senses.example: This theory has been tested in the laboratory.
senses.example_zh: 這個理論已在實驗室測試過。

senses.example: We witnessed the destruction of a town by the earthquake.
senses.example_zh: 我們目睹地震摧毀一座城鎮。

senses.example: Living conditions in the mountain area are very primitive.
senses.example_zh: 山區的生活條件十分原始。

senses.example: Our teacher is severe, so we are afraid of her.
senses.example_zh: 我們的老師很嚴格，所以我們都怕她。

senses.example: His injuries were quite severe, and he bled a lot.
senses.example_zh: 他的傷勢很嚴重，有大量出血的情形。

senses.example: You need to take special care at the curve of the road.
senses.example_zh: 你過彎道時要特別小心。

senses.example: Maria is a beautiful woman with nice curves.
senses.example_zh: 瑪莉亞是身材姣好的美女。

senses.example: The river curves around the side of the hill.
senses.example_zh: 這條河蜿蜒流過山邊。

senses.example: Her active participation in community service is admirable.
senses.example_zh: 她積極參與社區服務，令人讚賞。

senses.example: Many patients are fighting for the right to die with dignity.
senses.example_zh: 許多病患想爭取尊嚴離世的權利。

senses.example: Lying is beneath my dignity.
senses.example_zh: 說謊有損我的尊嚴（我不屑說謊）。

senses.example: The twins look alike, but they differ in personality.
senses.example_zh: 那對雙胞胎看起來相似，個性卻不同。

entries.word: A differ / be different from B in N

senses.zh: A 與 B 在～方面不同
senses.example: This car differs from that one in color. = This car is different from that one in color.
senses.example_zh: 這輛車與那輛車顏色不同。

senses.example: All research has its limitations.
senses.example_zh: 所有研究都有其所不能及之處。

senses.example: We have limited resources but unlimited desires.
senses.example_zh: 我們的資源有限，慾望卻無窮。

senses.example: The reduction of cost will be reflected on the price.
senses.example_zh: 成本降低將反映在價格上。

senses.example: Democracy is a valuable product of human civilization.
senses.example_zh: 民主是人類文明的寶貴產物。

senses.example: I asked the soldier what he was in civilian life.
senses.example_zh: 我問那位軍人未服役前從事什麼工作。

senses.example: Many civilians were killed in the missile attack.
senses.example_zh: 許多平民死於這次飛彈攻擊。

senses.example: Treating animals like this is against my conscience.
senses.example_zh: 這樣對待動物有違我的良心。

senses.example: Professor Chen gave us a lecture on Italian art.
senses.example_zh: 陳教授講授一堂關於義大利藝術的課。

senses.example: The professor lectured on nanotechnology to us.
senses.example_zh: 教授對我們講授奈米科技相關課程。

senses.example: The audience gave the lecturer a big hand.
senses.example_zh: 聽眾給予演講者熱烈的掌聲。

senses.example: She got a new job as a lecturer.
senses.example_zh: 她找到擔任講師的新工作。

senses.example: Please don't disturb him.
senses.example_zh: 請別打擾他。

senses.zh: 感到不安的／令人不安的
senses.example: He is not disturbed at all about these disturbing rumors.
senses.example_zh: 他對於這些令人不安的謠傳，沒有絲毫不安。

senses.example: It is still impossible to predict the occurrence of earthquakes.
senses.example_zh: 預測地震發生仍是不可能的。

senses.example: Many people have made predictions about the doomsday.
senses.example_zh: 許多人都曾做過世界末日的預言。

senses.zh: （整合資料與數據後所做的）預報、預測
senses.example: The weather forecast predicted that another storm was approaching.
senses.example_zh: 天氣預報預測另一場暴風雨即將來襲。

senses.example: No one can forecast when the next earthquake will happen.
senses.example_zh: 無人能預測下次地震發生的時間。

senses.zh: 停止【~ N / V-ing / to V】
senses.example: Without love, society will cease existing.
senses.example_zh: 社會因缺乏愛而瓦解。

senses.example: They have called a temporary ceasefire in the region.
senses.example_zh: 他們在這個地區暫時休兵。

senses.example: People usually dress up when going to the opera.
senses.example_zh: 人們聽歌劇時通常盛裝前往。

senses.example: Chinese operas and Taiwanese operas are traditional art but attract far fewer viewers than soap operas.
senses.example_zh: 平劇與歌仔戲均為傳統藝術，收視觀眾卻比肥皂劇少很多。

senses.example: The museum is open to the public without restriction.
senses.example_zh: 這個博物館無條件對外開放。

senses.example: Some shows have age restrictions.
senses.example_zh: 有些節目有年齡限制。

senses.example: The law should be rigidly enforced.
senses.example_zh: 執法應該嚴格。

senses.example: The enforcement of intellectual property rights is very important.
senses.example_zh: 智慧財產權的落實非常重要。

senses.example: He shows no objection to my idea.
senses.example_zh: 他不反對我的想法。

senses.example: The main objective is to improve children's nutrition.
senses.example_zh: 主要目標是改善兒童的營養。

senses.example: The viewpoints expressed in this book are objective.
senses.example_zh: 這本書裡表達的觀點是客觀的。

senses.example: It will complicate the situation if we invite his ex-girlfriend to the party.
senses.example_zh: 我們若邀請他的前女友參加派對會讓情況更複雜。

senses.example: I can never learn to operate these complicated machines.
senses.example_zh: 我永遠學不會操作這些複雜的機器。

senses.example: The fall of the Berlin Wall marked the end of an old era.
senses.example_zh: 柏林圍牆的傾塌標記一個舊時代的結束。

senses.zh: 依賴的【~ on sb. for sth.】
senses.example: He is still dependent on his parents for living expenses.
senses.example_zh: 他仍依賴父母提供生活費。

senses.zh: （生活所需仰賴他人的）家眷、食客、隨從
senses.example: The factory employs around 1000 workers who have approximately 3000 dependents.
senses.example_zh: 這間工廠僱用約一千名員工，養活近三千位眷屬。

senses.example: We need to reduce our dependence on nuclear energy.
senses.example_zh: 我們需要減少對核能的依賴。

senses.example: I need someone dependable to do the job.
senses.example_zh: 我需要一位可靠的人來做這件事。

senses.example: Waves of different wavelengths can have the same frequency.
senses.example_zh: 不同波長的波段也可以有同樣頻率。

senses.example: If wages go up, prices will go up, too. That is simple logic.
senses.example_zh: 物價隨工資上漲，這是簡單的邏輯。

senses.example: You need to learn how to construct a logical argument.
senses.example_zh: 你必須學習建構合乎邏輯的論點。

senses.example: The plot of the TV series was illogical.
senses.example_zh: 這部電視影集的情節不合邏輯。

senses.example: The Jews are said to have a talent for commerce.
senses.example_zh: 據說猶太人有商業天分。

senses.example: This mineral doesn't have much commercial value.
senses.example_zh: 這種礦物沒有商業價值。

senses.example: There are too many commercials on TV.
senses.example_zh: 電視上的廣告太多了。

senses.example: I think Valentine's Day, Christmas and Halloween are all highly-commercialized.
senses.example_zh: 我認為情人節、聖誕節與萬聖夜都被高度商業化。

senses.example: French cuisine emphasizes attractive presentation.
senses.example_zh: 法式料理重視精緻擺盤。

senses.example: I will give a presentation today.
senses.example_zh: 我今天將要口頭簡報。

senses.example: He made an admission that he was having an affair with his assistant.
senses.example_zh: 他承認與助理發生婚外情。

senses.example: The reporter was granted the admission into the conference.
senses.example_zh: 這名記者獲准進入會場。

senses.example: The Zoo has no admission charge.
senses.example_zh: 動物園的門票免費。

senses.example: He admitted his guilt after he failed a lie-detector test.
senses.example_zh: 他在測謊失敗後就俯首認罪了。

senses.example: He has a sense of guilt about not doing his homework.
senses.example_zh: 他因為沒寫功課而有罪惡感。

senses.example: He was found not guilty of the murder of his wife.
senses.example_zh: 關於他妻子的謀殺案，他獲判無罪。

senses.example: I felt guilty about forgetting my wife's birthday.
senses.example_zh: 我因忘記太太的生日而感到愧疚。

senses.zh: 指揮官、海軍中校、副艦長
senses.example: He became a commander at the age of thirty-five.
senses.example_zh: 他三十五歲就當上指揮官。

senses.example: The president is the commander-in-chief of the armed forces.
senses.example_zh: 總統是三軍總司令。

senses.example: Almost every household in America has at least one computer.
senses.example_zh: 在美國幾乎每個家庭都至少有一臺電腦。

senses.example: Do you know how much energy your household appliances use?
senses.example_zh: 你知道你的家電耗電量嗎？

senses.example: Yo-Yo Ma has become a household name.
senses.example_zh: 馬友友是個家喻戶曉的名字。

senses.example: Most senators are favorable to the proposal.
senses.example_zh: 大部分參議員都贊成這個提案。

senses.example: Warm, wet weather is favorable for infection.
senses.example_zh: 暖溼的天氣助長病菌感染。

senses.example: He has made a favorable impression on me.
senses.example_zh: 我對他印象不錯。

senses.example: He spoke favorably of you.
senses.example_zh: 他對你的評價頗高。

senses.example: Our products compare favorably with all the leading brands.
senses.example_zh: 我們的產品與其他主要品牌相比更勝一籌。

senses.example: The sea conditions are unfavorable for shipping.
senses.example_zh: 現在的海況不利於航行。

senses.example: The smartphone has multiple functions.
senses.example_zh: 智慧型手機有多重功能。

senses.example: She studied psychology at Yale.
senses.example_zh: 她在耶魯大學唸心理學。

senses.example: She knows the psychology of teenagers very well.
senses.example_zh: 她非常了解青少年的心理。

senses.example: The patient's psychological state is stable now.
senses.example_zh: 這位病人現在的心理狀態很穩定。

senses.example: Freud was a distinguished psychologist.
senses.example_zh: 佛洛依德是位傑出的心理學家。

senses.zh: 裝備、配備【~ A with B】
senses.example: Some of the classrooms are equipped with air conditioners.
senses.example_zh: 有些教室裝有冷氣。

senses.example: The new equipment cost a total of $250,000.
senses.example_zh: 這些新設備共花費二十五萬元。

senses.example: In the west, people are dressed in black at the funeral.
senses.example_zh: 在西方的葬禮上人們身著黑衣。

senses.example: The illustrator has great enthusiasm for music.
senses.example_zh: 這位插畫家相當熱衷於音樂。

senses.example: The commander gave the order to launch the missile.
senses.example_zh: 指揮官下令發射飛彈。

senses.example: They are going to launch the ship tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 他們將於明天讓這艘船正式下水。

senses.example: They launched a campaign to reform the Labor Standard Law.
senses.example_zh: 他們發起改革《勞基法》的運動。

senses.example: The system has been very unstable since its launch.
senses.example_zh: 這個系統自啟用後就很不穩定。

senses.example: The launch of the ship will be delayed due to bad weather.
senses.example_zh: 這艘船的首航因天候不佳將被延後。

senses.example: The beautiful scenery inspired the poet to write a great poem.
senses.example_zh: 美麗的景致啟發詩人創作出偉大的詩作。

senses.example: His speech inspired many people.
senses.example_zh: 他的演講激勵許多人。

senses.example: The president's speech was inspiring.
senses.example_zh: 總統的演說振奮人心。

senses.example: She got inspiration for her next novel from the picture.
senses.example_zh: 她從這幅畫中得到下一本小說的靈感。

senses.zh: 鼓舞者、給人靈感的人（物）
senses.example: She has been an inspiration to us all.
senses.example_zh: 她一直是我們的激勵者（她一直鼓舞著我們）。

senses.example: My parents give me an allowance of two thousand dollars a month.
senses.example_zh: 我的父母每個月給我兩千塊零用錢。

senses.example: We should live in harmony with nature.
senses.example_zh: 我們應與自然和諧共存。

senses.example: It is a song with complex harmonies.
senses.example_zh: 這首歌有複雜的和聲。

senses.example: I want to have a happy and harmonious family.
senses.example_zh: 我想要有一個快樂和諧的家庭。

senses.example: It is difficult to cope with two small children and a job.
senses.example_zh: 同時應付兩個小孩及工作很辛苦。

senses.example: Let's be realistic; I just can't afford to pay that much money.
senses.example_zh: 我們實際一點吧！我負擔不起那麼多錢。

senses.zh: 真實的、真正存在的、名符其實的

senses.example: I always purchase travel insurance before going on a trip.
senses.example_zh: 我在外出旅遊前都會投保旅遊險。

senses.zh: 投保【~ N for 金額 / ~ N against sth.】
senses.example: The museum insures the painting for ten million dollars.
senses.example_zh: 博物館為這幅畫投保一千萬元。

senses.zh: 投保【~ N for 金額 / ~ N against sth.】
senses.example: To get the loan, we have to insure the house against fire.
senses.example_zh: 我們為了申請貸款必須為房子投保火災險。

senses.example: She is one of the most outstanding students in my class.
senses.example_zh: 她是我班上最傑出的學生之一。

senses.example: The outstanding balance on my credit card this month is 10,000 dollars.
senses.example_zh: 這個月我的信用卡未付款是一萬元。

senses.example: The train for London is going to depart in five minutes.
senses.example_zh: 前往倫敦的火車將在五分鐘後出發。

senses.example: His departure was delayed because of the bad weather.
senses.example_zh: 因為天氣不好，所以他延後離開。

senses.example: Movies can be considered a form of visual art.
senses.example_zh: 電影可視為一種視覺藝術。

senses.example: We watched a movie in the audio-visual classroom.
senses.example_zh: 我們在視聽教室看了一部電影。

senses.example: I tried to visualize his hometown as he described it.
senses.example_zh: 我試著想像他描述的家鄉樣貌。

senses.example: It is fun to read books of rhymes.
senses.example_zh: 閱讀韻文書很有趣。

senses.example: "Hook" is a rhyme for "book."
senses.example_zh: hook 是 book 的同韻字。

senses.example: "Look" rhymes with "book."
senses.example_zh: look 與 book 押韻。

senses.example: I like to read science fiction and horror stories.
senses.example_zh: 我喜歡讀科幻小說與驚悚故事。

senses.example: Batman and Spider-man are both fictional characters.
senses.example_zh: 蝙蝠俠與蜘蛛人都是虛構的角色。

senses.zh: 禁止【~ N / sb. to V】
senses.example: My parents forbid my going out at night. = My parents forbid me to go out at night.
senses.example_zh: 我父母禁止我晚上外出。

senses.zh: 娛樂、逗～開心【~ sb. with sth.】
senses.example: The clown entertained the children with magic tricks.
senses.example_zh: 小丑變魔術逗小孩子開心。

senses.example: The mayor often entertains foreign guests in this hotel.
senses.example_zh: 市長常在這家飯店招待外賓。

senses.example: The movie offers entertainment for all ages.
senses.example_zh: 這部電影老少咸宜。

senses.example: I look forward to entering the entertainment business.
senses.example_zh: 我渴望進入演藝界。

senses.example: The government promised to restore the economy.
senses.example_zh: 政府承諾重振經濟。

senses.example: We hope to restore order as soon as possible.
senses.example_zh: 我們希望能盡快恢復秩序。

senses.example: The tea was served in delicate porcelain cups.
senses.example_zh: 這茶以精緻的瓷杯盛裝。

senses.example: The delicacy of the crown amazed all the visitors.
senses.example_zh: 這頂皇冠的精緻度讓遊客嘆為觀止。

senses.example: The night market is full of delicacies.
senses.example_zh: 夜市充滿美食。

senses.example: The Great Wall is really magnificent.
senses.example_zh: 萬里長城真是壯觀。

senses.example: The magnificence of Taj Mahal attracts millions of visitors every year.
senses.example_zh: 泰姬瑪哈陵的壯麗每年吸引數百萬觀光客造訪。

senses.example: A moderate level of anxiety is helpful and productive.
senses.example_zh: 適度的焦慮是有益且具生產力的。

senses.example: Everyone can see his anxiety to please the boss.
senses.example_zh: 每個人都看得出他急於討好老闆。

senses.example: It was difficult to get precise information at war.
senses.example_zh: 在戰爭時獲得精確資訊是很困難的。

senses.example: He arrived here at precisely four o'clock.
senses.example_zh: 他抵達時正好四點整。

senses.example: The class was dismissed at four o'clock.
senses.example_zh: 這堂課四點下課。

senses.zh: 鄙視、摒除【~ N as adj. / N】
senses.example: He dismissed my idea as unrealistic. = He dismissed my idea as a fantasy.
senses.example_zh: 他鄙視我的想法，認為它不切實際。

senses.example: Sue resembles her mother closely in face and in personality.
senses.example_zh: 蘇的長相與個性和母親相像。

senses.example: The city needs to improve its public transportation system.
senses.example_zh: 這座城市需要改善大眾運輸系統。

senses.zh: 運輸工具或系統（= transport 英式）
senses.example: You can go on foot or by any means of transportation.
senses.example_zh: 你可以徒步或使用任何交通工具。

senses.example: The experts made a safety inspection of the old building.
senses.example_zh: 專家為那棟老舊建築進行安全檢查。

senses.example: It is unwise to show your terror to the enemy.
senses.example_zh: 在敵人面前露出恐懼是不智的。

senses.example: The little girl ran away in terror.
senses.example_zh: 那位小女孩驚恐地跑開。

senses.example: The terrorists planted a bomb in a railway station.
senses.example_zh: 恐怖分子在火車站放置炸彈。

senses.example: 911 is one of the most known terrorist attacks.
senses.example_zh: 九一一是最為人所知的恐怖攻擊事件之一。

senses.example: Many countries get involved in the war against terrorism.
senses.example_zh: 許多國家參與反恐戰爭。

senses.example: His dream is to become a professional ballet dancer.
senses.example_zh: 他的夢想是成為職業芭蕾舞者。

senses.example: Harry is a garage mechanic.
senses.example_zh: 哈利是一名修車師傅。

senses.example: He can fix any mechanical problem.
senses.example_zh: 他能修理任何機械故障。

senses.example: I am tired of mechanical jobs.
senses.example_zh: 我對機械式的工作感到厭倦。

senses.example: Steven majored in mechanics in college.
senses.example_zh: 史蒂芬大學時主修機械學。

senses.example: He is very modest about his achievements.
senses.example_zh: 他對自己的成就非常謙虛。

senses.example: They live in a modest house.
senses.example_zh: 他們住在一間樸實的房子裡。

senses.example: "I still have much to learn," he said with modesty.
senses.example_zh: 他語帶謙虛地說：「我還有很多要學習的。」

senses.example: We were impressed by the modesty of his room.
senses.example_zh: 他的房間樸實無華，使我們印象深刻。

senses.example: It is peculiar that they just left without saying goodbye.
senses.example_zh: 他們不告而別，真是奇怪。

senses.zh: 特有的、獨有的【~ to N】
senses.example: This accent is peculiar to Indians.
senses.example_zh: 這是印度人特有的腔調。

senses.example: The gallery is famous for its collection of modern art.
senses.example_zh: 這家畫廊以現代藝術的收藏而聞名。

senses.example: Few can resist the attraction of a freshly made pie.
senses.example_zh: 很少人能抗拒剛出爐的派的吸引力。

senses.example: The beautiful beach is the island's main attraction.
senses.example_zh: 美麗的海灘是這座島嶼的主要觀光景點。

senses.example: The school has a good reputation for its moral education.
senses.example_zh: 這所學校在德育方面聲譽卓著。

senses.example: What I said is the absolute truth.
senses.example_zh: 我說的絕對是實話。

senses.example: I have absolute trust in him.
senses.example_zh: 我對他完全信任。

senses.example: You must be absolutely silent, or the birds won't appear.
senses.example_zh: 你必須保持絕對安靜，否則鳥兒不會出現。

senses.example: The professor supported my proposal absolutely.
senses.example_zh: 教授完全支持我的提案。

senses.example: It is still too early to predict the outcome of the election.
senses.example_zh: 現在預測選舉的結果言之過早。

senses.example: The general decided to withdraw his troops.
senses.example_zh: 將軍決定撤軍。

senses.example: The old lady wanted to withdraw all her money from the bank.
senses.example_zh: 老婦人想提領她在銀行的所有存款。

senses.example: The prosecutor refused to withdraw the case.
senses.example_zh: 檢察官拒絕撤回此案。

senses.example: We plan to invite some colleagues and friends to our party.
senses.example_zh: 我們打算邀請同事與朋友參加派對。

senses.example: We erected a monument to honor those who lost their lives for our country.
senses.example_zh: 我們豎立紀念碑紀念殉國的烈士。

senses.example: His paintings are artistic and creative.
senses.example_zh: 他的畫作具藝術性及創造性。

senses.example: Becky has an artistic eye for pottery.
senses.example_zh: 貝姬有鑑賞陶器的眼光。

senses.zh: 等待（比 wait 正式）【~ N = wait for N】
senses.example: We are awaiting his arrival. = We are waiting for his arrival.
senses.example_zh: 我們正等待他的到來。

senses.example: I wish to convey my apologies.
senses.example_zh: 我想表達我的歉意。

senses.example: My father's room conveys an impression of seriousness.
senses.example_zh: 我父親的臥室傳達一種嚴肅的印象。

senses.example: The train conveys over five hundred passengers every day.
senses.example_zh: 這班列車每天載送五百名以上的乘客。

senses.example: They grind the grain into flour to make bread.
senses.example_zh: 他們將穀物磨成麵粉來製作麵包。

senses.example: Season the lamb with a few grinds of fresh black pepper.
senses.example_zh: 用現磨的黑胡椒為羊肉調味。

senses.zh: 感恩的【~ to sb. for sth.】
senses.example: We are most grateful to you for your help.
senses.example_zh: 我們非常感激您的幫助。

senses.example: Many children are ungrateful to their parents.
senses.example_zh: 許多孩子對父母不知感恩。

senses.example: She sent them a present to express her gratitude.
senses.example_zh: 她寄給他們一份禮物表達謝意。

senses.example: The ladies danced with grace at the party.
senses.example_zh: 淑女們在宴會中優雅地跳舞。

senses.example: We survived the accident by God's grace.
senses.example_zh: 我們倚靠上帝的恩典才能在意外中存活下來。

senses.example: The antique dresser graces the homely room.
senses.example_zh: 這張骨董梳妝臺使樸實無華的房間增色不少。

senses.example: The mayor will grace my wedding with his presence.
senses.example_zh: 市長的出席為我的婚禮增添不少光彩。

senses.example: She is a very graceful lady.
senses.example_zh: 她是位非常優雅的女士。

senses.example: Judges looked at the contestants with a gracious smile.
senses.example_zh: 評審們帶著親切的笑容看著參賽者。

senses.example: We had a dispute about where to take a vacation.
senses.example_zh: 我們對於度假地點有過爭論。

senses.zh: 爭執、爭議【~ with sb. about / over sth.】
senses.example: He disputed with his father over a political issue.
senses.example_zh: 他與父親為了一個政治議題起爭執。

senses.example: The ownership of this land is still in dispute.
senses.example_zh: 這塊地的所有權仍有爭議。

senses.zh: 把～轉變成～【~ A into B】
senses.example: Taiwan has been transformed into an industrial country.
senses.example_zh: 臺灣已轉變為一個工業國。

senses.example: Many men consider wearing a beard a symbol of maturity.
senses.example_zh: 許多男性認為蓄鬍是成熟的象徵。

senses.example: A tree reaches its maturity when it starts producing flowers or fruits.
senses.example_zh: 樹木在達到成熟期時會開花結果。

senses.zh: 完全發育的、成熟穩重的、考慮成熟的、周到的

senses.example: The parents' neglect of their children is due to selfishness.
senses.example_zh: 父母對孩子的忽略是自私所造成的。

senses.example: As a good worker, you should never neglect your duty.
senses.example_zh: 身為一名好員工你絕不能怠忽職守。

senses.example: The committee has split into two groups on this issue.
senses.example_zh: 委員會在這個議題上分成兩派。

senses.example: A flash of lightning split the tree into two.
senses.example_zh: 一道閃電把樹劈成兩半。

senses.example: Let's split the cost.
senses.example_zh: 我們一起分攤費用吧！

senses.example: My parents split up when I was very young.
senses.example_zh: 在我很小的時候父母就離婚了。

senses.example: I notice that there is a split in his shorts.
senses.example_zh: 我注意到他的短褲有一處裂縫。

senses.example: Differences in their lifestyles led to the split in their marriage.
senses.example_zh: 生活習慣的歧異導致他們婚姻失和。

senses.example: They challenged the accuracy of the statistics.
senses.example_zh: 他們質疑統計數字的正確性。

senses.example: Computers calculate with amazing accuracy.
senses.example_zh: 電腦以驚人的準確度運算。

senses.example: No parents can endure the pain of losing their child.
senses.example_zh: 沒有父母能忍受喪子之痛。

senses.example: Their marriage endured for fifty years.
senses.example_zh: 他們的婚姻持續了五十年。

senses.example: What contributes to the enduring appeal of Sherlock Holmes?
senses.example_zh: 促成福爾摩斯持久不墜的吸引力是什麼呢？

senses.example: Members enjoy many privileges and benefits.
senses.example_zh: 會員可享有許多特權與福利。

senses.example: It's a privilege to be part of this team.
senses.example_zh: 很榮幸成為這個團隊的一員。

senses.example: As an ambassador, he enjoys privileged status.
senses.example_zh: 身為一名大使他享有特權身分。

senses.example: The legend of King Arthur has been told and retold for centuries.
senses.example_zh: 幾世紀以來，亞瑟王的傳奇不斷被傳誦。

senses.example: Dr. Li is a legend at our school.
senses.example_zh: 李博士是我們學校的傳奇人物。

senses.example: Legend has it that the castle was washed into the sea.
senses.example_zh: 傳說那座城堡被沖到海裡去了。

senses.example: The police have made a sketch of the suspect.
senses.example_zh: 警方已經完成嫌犯的素描。

senses.example: I like to sketch the faces of my colleagues.
senses.example_zh: 我喜歡畫同事的臉部素描。

senses.example: He sketched out a proposal for the new program.
senses.example_zh: 他為新節目草擬了一份提案。

senses.example: We should cultivate an appreciation of art in our students.
senses.example_zh: 我們應該培養學生對藝術的鑑賞力。

senses.example: Words cannot express our appreciation for your support.
senses.example_zh: 我們對於你的支持，感恩不言謝。

senses.example: He received a certificate in appreciation of his long service.
senses.example_zh: 他獲頒一張獎狀，感謝他的多年服務。

senses.example: We went on a tour to the biggest city in Japan, namely, Tokyo.
senses.example_zh: 我們去日本最大的城市旅遊，也就是東京。

senses.example: World War II was a disaster to all humanity.
senses.example_zh: 二次世界大戰對全人類而言是一大浩劫。

senses.example: Mencius believed that humanity was fundamentally good.
senses.example_zh: 孟子相信人性本善。

senses.example: I like the humanities more than the sciences.
senses.example_zh: 我喜愛人文學科勝於自然學科。

senses.example: Joe is a well-known humanitarian.
senses.example_zh: 喬是一位著名的人道主義者。

senses.example: The Red Cross is famous for its humanitarian efforts.
senses.example_zh: 紅十字會以人道主義的付出而著稱。

senses.example: He is in a state of depression.
senses.example_zh: 他現在情緒低落。

senses.example: The high unemployment rate indicates a severe depression.
senses.example_zh: 高失業率顯示經濟嚴重不景氣。

senses.example: Jack has been a loyal worker in this company for thirty years.
senses.example_zh: 三十年來，傑克一直是這家公司的忠實員工。

senses.example: I will always be loyal to my country.
senses.example_zh: 我永遠效忠祖國。

senses.example: Benedict was disloyal to his country during wartime.
senses.example_zh: 班乃迪克在戰時對自己的國家不忠。

senses.example: Soldiers swore loyalty to their country before going to war.
senses.example_zh: 士兵們在出征之前發誓效忠國家。

senses.example: I read the first draft and thought it was very good.
senses.example_zh: 我讀過初稿，覺得非常棒！

senses.example: Many people avoided the draft by putting on a lot of weight.
senses.example_zh: 以往許多人藉著大幅增重逃避兵役。

senses.example: He drafted a speech for the President.
senses.example_zh: 他替總統草擬講稿。

senses.example: Tim was drafted into the Army.
senses.example_zh: 提姆受徵召進入陸軍。

senses.example: The economy is slowly showing signs of recovery.
senses.example_zh: 經濟慢慢顯露出復甦的跡象。

senses.example: The recovery of my lost bike seems impossible.
senses.example_zh: 我要找回遺失的腳踏車似乎不太可能。

senses.example: We must devise a way to carry out our plan.
senses.example_zh: 我們必須想出一個執行計畫的方法。

senses.example: Don't interfere with my work.
senses.example_zh: 別妨礙我工作。

senses.example: We should not interfere in others' business.
senses.example_zh: 我們不該干涉別人的事。

senses.example: The submarine can stay underwater for two days.
senses.example_zh: 這艘潛水艇可以在水底下待兩天。

senses.example: Submarine cables carry telecommunication signals.
senses.example_zh: 海底電纜攜帶電子通訊訊號。

senses.example: What you said is too abstract. Can you make it more concrete?
senses.example_zh: 你說的內容太抽象了，可否再具體一點？

senses.example: Please write an abstract of the paper in about three hundred words.
senses.example_zh: 請為這篇論文寫一篇約三百字的摘要。

senses.example: Please give me a concrete example to clarify your idea.
senses.example_zh: 請用具體的例子闡明你的想法。

senses.example: This house is built of concrete.
senses.example_zh: 這棟房子是用混凝土蓋成的。

senses.example: Concrete the floor and level the surface before laying the tiles.
senses.example_zh: 鋪磁磚前先在地板上倒入水泥並推平。

senses.zh: （包含自然和人造的）陸上景觀
senses.example: The small island's beautiful landscape is similar to that of Taiwan.
senses.example_zh: 這座小島美麗的景觀與臺灣相似。

senses.example: I'd like to buy some flowering plants to landscape my backyard.
senses.example_zh: 我想要買些開花植物美化後院。

senses.example: A word can have various meanings depending on its context.
senses.example_zh: 視上下文意一個字會有多種不同意義。

senses.example: Bill Gates is a pioneer in the field of software development.
senses.example_zh: 比爾‧蓋茲是軟體研發方面的先鋒。

senses.example: He is good at pioneering (in) new markets.
senses.example_zh: 他擅長開拓新市場。

senses.zh: 接近的方法、途徑【~ to N】
senses.example: There's no access to the house.
senses.example_zh: 無法接近這棟房子。

senses.zh: 接近、使用的機會【~ to N】
senses.example: People living in the city have access to excellent libraries.
senses.example_zh: 都市居民擁有優質圖書館的使用權。

senses.example: You can access your accounts through online banking.
senses.example_zh: 你可以透過網路銀行登入帳戶。

senses.zh: 令人難以相信的、不可置信的
senses.example: It is incredible that no one has noticed these mistakes.
senses.example_zh: 真令人難以置信，竟然沒有人注意到這些錯誤。

senses.example: He will evaluate the possibility of modernizing the facilities.
senses.example_zh: 他將評估設施現代化的可能性。

senses.example: They conducted an evaluation of her job performance.
senses.example_zh: 他們對她的工作表現進行評估。

senses.example: She worked hard to fulfill her ambition of becoming a super model.
senses.example_zh: 她努力實踐成為超級名模的抱負。

senses.example: Teaching is a fulfilling job.
senses.example_zh: 教書是份充實的工作。

senses.example: The troops quickly retreated to a safe place.
senses.example_zh: 軍隊很快地撤退到安全地點。

senses.example: I retreated to the country for a few days to relax.
senses.example_zh: 我到鄉下待幾天，放鬆一下。

senses.zh: 保證【~ N / that S + V】
senses.example: We guarantee delivery to your door within twenty-four hours.
senses.example_zh: 我們保證二十四小時內送貨到府。

senses.zh: 保證【~ N / that S + V】
senses.example: We guarantee that there are no preservatives in our foods.
senses.example_zh: 我們的食品保證不含防腐劑。

senses.example: Our computers come with a one-year guarantee.
senses.example_zh: 我們的電腦有一年保固。

senses.example: Good is the contrary of evil.
senses.example_zh: 善的反面是惡。

senses.example: I thought it would be very hot today. On the contrary, it's cool.
senses.example_zh: 我本來以為今天會很熱；相反地，今天很涼爽。

senses.example: Our plan encountered contrary opinions in the meeting.
senses.example_zh: 我們的計畫在會議中遭到相反意見的反對。

senses.example: Contrary to our expectations, he won the contest.
senses.example_zh: 出乎我們的意料，他贏得比賽。

senses.example: I can't stand the noise from the road drill.
senses.example_zh: 我無法忍受路上鑽孔機發出的噪音。

senses.example: We had lots of drills on tenses in the grammar class.
senses.example_zh: 我們在文法課上反覆做時態練習。

senses.example: We had a fire drill at school last week.
senses.example_zh: 上星期我們學校有一場防火演習。

senses.example: I drilled a hole in the wall with an electric drill.
senses.example_zh: 我用電鑽在牆上鑽了一個洞。

senses.example: The team was well-drilled and well-organized.
senses.example_zh: 這支隊伍訓練有素，井然有序。

senses.example: Teenagers are easily influenced by their peers.
senses.example_zh: 青少年容易受同儕影響。

senses.example: The driver was peering at the road sign.
senses.example_zh: 司機正仔細端詳路標。

senses.example: It is hard for most teenagers to withstand peer pressure.
senses.example_zh: 多數青少年難以承受同儕壓力。

senses.example: Please make an estimate of the cost.
senses.example_zh: 請估算費用。

senses.example: My estimate of his ability is wrong.
senses.example_zh: 我對他能力的評價是錯誤的。

senses.example: They estimate that the construction will take four years.
senses.example_zh: 他們預估這項工程會花四年時間。

senses.example: The shift in the wind direction took place after the storm passed.
senses.example_zh: 暴風雨通過後風向就改變了。

senses.example: Today I am on the day shift.
senses.example_zh: 今天我值日班。

senses.example: He shifted his attention from still images to motion pictures.
senses.example_zh: 他將注意力由靜止圖像轉移至動畫。

senses.zh: 遭遇（尤指遇見敵人）【~ with】
senses.example: I had a frightening encounter with a big wild dog.
senses.example_zh: 我曾有遇過大野狗的可怕經歷。

senses.example: The U.S. troops encountered fierce resistance from the enemy.
senses.example_zh: 美軍遭遇敵軍猛烈的抵抗。

senses.example: I was so happy to encounter the author of my favorite book.
senses.example_zh: 我很高興遇見我最喜愛的書籍作者。

senses.example: She leaned forward and whispered something in my ear.
senses.example_zh: 她傾向前，在我耳邊說悄悄話。

senses.example: He leaned on a tree, taking a rest.
senses.example_zh: 他靠著一棵樹休息。

senses.example: He leaned his bike against the wall.
senses.example_zh: 他將腳踏車靠牆停放。

senses.example: At eighty-two, my grandfather was lean and strong.
senses.example_zh: 我祖父八十二歲時仍精瘦健壯。

senses.example: I eat only lean meat.
senses.example_zh: 我只吃瘦肉。

senses.example: There are many cracks in the old wall.
senses.example_zh: 舊牆上有許多裂縫。

senses.example: She fell off the tree and cracked a bone in her leg.
senses.example_zh: 她從樹上跌下來，摔斷腿骨。

senses.example: The wall cracked and crumbled.
senses.example_zh: 牆壁裂開然後崩塌。

senses.example: We finally cracked the codes.
senses.example_zh: 我們終於破解了密碼。

senses.example: The whip cracked across his back again and again.
senses.example_zh: 鞭子不斷打在他的背上劈啪作響。

senses.example: He was happy with the transfer.
senses.example_zh: 他很高興被調職。

senses.example: The official transfer of the ownership takes a few days to complete.
senses.example_zh: 正式的所有權移轉需要幾天才能完成。

senses.example: After a year at Stanford, he transferred to Oxford.
senses.example_zh: 他在史丹佛就讀一年後轉學到牛津。

senses.example: She transferred the house to her daughter.
senses.example_zh: 她將房子過戶給女兒。

senses.example: Your call will be transferred to the voice mail.
senses.example_zh: 您的電話將轉接到語音信箱。

senses.example: The boat drifted farther and farther away.
senses.example_zh: 船愈漂愈遠。

senses.example: A lot of factors can influence the drift of clouds.
senses.example_zh: 許多因素會影響雲的飄動。

senses.example: I am not interested in the exhibit of ancient weapons at all.
senses.example_zh: 我對古代武器的展覽興致缺缺。

senses.example: Please do not touch the exhibits.
senses.example_zh: 請不要觸摸展覽品。

senses.example: He has exhibited his works in many cities.
senses.example_zh: 他已在許多城市展出作品。

senses.example: He conceded defeat and called to congratulate his opponent.
senses.example_zh: 他承認失敗並致電祝賀對手。

senses.example: The team now has four victories and two defeats.
senses.example_zh: 該隊戰績四勝兩敗。

senses.example: Napoleon was defeated at the battle of Waterloo.
senses.example_zh: 拿破崙在滑鐵盧之役中戰敗。

senses.example: We have a spare tire in the trunk of our car.
senses.example_zh: 我們的後車廂裡有備胎。

senses.example: I have no spare money to spend on computer games.
senses.example_zh: 我沒有多餘的錢可以花在電腦遊戲上。

senses.example: The king spared his life.
senses.example_zh: 國王饒他一命。

senses.example: Can you spare me a few minutes?
senses.example_zh: 你能給我幾分鐘嗎？

senses.example: My battery is low. Do you have a spare?
senses.example_zh: 我的電池快沒電了，你有備用的嗎？

senses.example: The witch put a curse on the prince.
senses.example_zh: 巫婆對王子下咒。

senses.example: He muttered a curse upon the selfishness of his friends.
senses.example_zh: 他低聲咒罵朋友們的自私。

senses.example: With all those misfortunes, he must be under a curse.
senses.example_zh: 他遭遇這麼多不幸，肯定是受到詛咒。

senses.example: The wizard cursed the princess to turn into a fox every night.
senses.example_zh: 巫師詛咒公主每天晚上都變成狐狸。

senses.example: He cursed all the misfortunes happening to him.
senses.example_zh: 他咒罵所有降臨在他身上的厄運。

senses.example: The soldiers surrendered to their enemy.
senses.example_zh: 士兵們向敵軍投降。

senses.example: The thief surrendered himself to the police.
senses.example_zh: 這名小偷向警方自首。

senses.example: The terrorists have refused to surrender their weapons.
senses.example_zh: 這些恐怖分子拒絕繳械。

senses.example: General Wood would accept unconditional surrender only.
senses.example_zh: 伍德將軍只接受無條件投降。

senses.example: He examined his car and found a scratch on the hood.
senses.example_zh: 他仔細檢查他的車，發現引擎蓋上有一道刮痕。

senses.example: She was unharmed apart from a few cuts and scratches.
senses.example_zh: 她除了幾道割傷和擦傷外沒受什麼傷。

senses.example: Before repainting the wall, you have to scratch the old paint off.
senses.example_zh: 你在重新粉刷牆壁前，必須先刮掉舊漆。

senses.example: Don't scratch the mosquito bite.
senses.example_zh: 不要抓蚊子咬的地方。

senses.zh: 助動詞（= auxiliary verb，簡寫 aux）
senses.example: "Can," "may," "should," and "will" are all auxiliaries.
senses.example_zh: 「能夠」、「可以」、「應該」與「將會」都是助動詞。

senses.example: People hope the reforms will bring better lives.
senses.example_zh: 人們期望改革能帶來更好的生活。

senses.example: The educational system must be radically reformed.
senses.example_zh: 教育制度必須大刀闊斧地改革。

senses.example: He reformed himself by getting rid of bad habits.
senses.example_zh: 他藉由革除惡習改頭換面。

senses.example: Nice is known for its picturesque scenery and agreeable weather.
senses.example_zh: 尼斯以如畫的美景及宜人天氣聞名。

senses.example: You are just saying that to annoy me.
senses.example_zh: 你說這些話無非是要惹我生氣。

senses.example: You should put waste paper in the recycling bin.
senses.example_zh: 你應該將廢紙放進回收箱。

senses.zh: （有蓋子的）大型收納箱、儲物箱
senses.example: Farmers harvest the rice, dry it, and store it in bins.
senses.example_zh: 農民收割稻作並在晒乾後存放於大儲藏箱中。

senses.example: Her mother-in-law gave her a heavy gold bracelet.
senses.example_zh: 她婆婆送她一只沉甸甸的金手鐲。

senses.example: She was clumsy and broke things all the time.
senses.example_zh: 她很笨拙，老是打破東西。

senses.example: I am very clumsy at needlework.
senses.example_zh: 我的針線活很糟。

senses.example: I wear earphones to listen to music in the library.
senses.example_zh: 我在圖書館會戴耳機聽音樂。

senses.example: Actors need to have rich facial expressions.
senses.example_zh: 演員需要豐富的臉部表情。

senses.example: I found my car covered with frost this morning.
senses.example_zh: 今天早上我發現車子覆蓋著霜。

senses.example: Frost caused serious damage to vegetable crops.
senses.example_zh: 霜害對蔬菜作物造成嚴重損害。

senses.example: The cold weather has frosted all the roofs.
senses.example_zh: 寒冷的天氣讓屋頂都結霜了。

senses.example: All the vegetables were frosted.
senses.example_zh: 所有蔬菜都被凍壞了。

senses.example: It is better to defrost frozen meat a few hours before cooking.
senses.example_zh: 烹煮冷凍肉類前最好提前幾小時解凍。

senses.zh: 憤怒的【~ with / at sb. / ~ at sth.】
senses.example: Jack was furious with me for ruining his party.
senses.example_zh: 傑克因我毀了他的宴會而憤怒。

senses.example: There have been several furious quarrels between the two parties.
senses.example_zh: 雙方已有多次激烈爭執。

senses.zh: （緊張、尷尬時）傻笑、嗤嗤笑、咯咯笑
senses.example: Sue gave a nervous giggle and blushed when Jim kissed her.
senses.example_zh: 當吉姆親蘇時，她滿臉通紅地傻笑。

senses.example: The baby giggled when the dog licked his toes.
senses.example_zh: 當狗兒舔小寶寶的腳趾頭時，他咯咯地笑個不停。

senses.example: Normally prepositions are placed before nouns.
senses.example_zh: 介系詞一般置於名詞前。

senses.example: Her hair gets greasy easily.
senses.example_zh: 她的頭髮容易變得油膩。

senses.example: "How are you?" is a common greeting.
senses.example_zh: 「你好嗎？」是常見的問候語。

senses.example: I recognized his handwriting.
senses.example_zh: 我認出他的筆跡。

senses.example: The bride said "I do" without hesitation.
senses.example_zh: 新娘毫不猶豫地說「我願意」。

senses.example: I hate interruptions when I am doing homework.
senses.example_zh: 我做功課時討厭被打擾。

senses.example: He showed great jealousy of their success.
senses.example_zh: 他對他們的成功表現出強烈的妒忌。

senses.example: An educated man is not necessarily a learned one.
senses.example_zh: 受過教育的人不見得就是有學問的人。

senses.example: I want to be a leisurely backpacker.
senses.example_zh: 我想成為悠閒的背包客。

senses.example: Every day, the old couple walked leisurely in the park.
senses.example_zh: 那對老夫婦每天都會悠閒地在公園裡散步。

senses.example: Only those who have a driver's license are allowed to drive.
senses.example_zh: 有駕照的人才能開車。

senses.zh: 許可、發給執照【~ N to V】
senses.example: All our doctors are licensed to practice medicine.
senses.example_zh: 我們所有醫生都有行醫的執照。

senses.example: Please read the manual carefully.
senses.example_zh: 請詳閱說明書。

senses.example: The steering mode was changed from automatic to manual.
senses.example_zh: 駕駛模式從自動改為手動。

senses.example: My room looks messy, but I can find anything I need.
senses.example_zh: 我的房間看似混亂，但我需要什麼都找的到。

senses.example: The road became very muddy after the rain.
senses.example_zh: 下過雨後路面變得泥濘不堪。

senses.example: She has a perfect oval face.
senses.example_zh: 她有完美的蛋形臉。

senses.example: Stadiums are often in the shape of an oval.
senses.example_zh: 體育館通常是橢圓形。

senses.example: I like all kinds of pasta, such as macaroni and lasagna.
senses.example_zh: 我喜歡各種義大利麵食，像通心粉和千層麵。

senses.example: Johnson has great power of persuasion.
senses.example_zh: 強生很有說服力。

senses.zh: 令人信服的、有說服力的
senses.example: The lawyer's arguments are very persuasive.
senses.example_zh: 這個律師的論點很有說服力。

senses.example: I am pessimistic about my chances of winning the lottery.
senses.example_zh: 我對自己中樂透的機率感到悲觀。

senses.example: Flies and mosquitoes are annoying pests.
senses.example_zh: 蒼蠅與蚊子都是惱人的害蟲。

senses.example: Linda is a pest. Naturally, she becomes a social outcast in her class.
senses.example_zh: 琳達是個令人討厭的人，自然而然她在班上人緣也差。

senses.example: Pesticides kill pests but they also damage people's health.
senses.example_zh: 殺蟲劑殺死害蟲，但也損害人類健康。

senses.example: He shows much interest in photography.
senses.example_zh: 他對攝影很有興趣。

senses.example: Leg cramps are common during pregnancy.
senses.example_zh: 懷孕期間腿部抽筋很常見。

senses.example: I found that I was pregnant.
senses.example_zh: 我發現我懷孕了。

senses.zh: 薄被、拼布被（厚度與薄毯差不多）
senses.example: These quilts have beautiful, intricate patterns.
senses.example_zh: 這些薄被子有美麗複雜的花色。

senses.example: She quilted a new baby quilt for her beloved granddaughter.
senses.example_zh: 她為心愛的孫女縫製一件新的嬰兒被。

senses.example: Comforters are definitely thicker than quilts.
senses.example_zh: 棉被肯定比拼布被厚實。

senses.example: My friend gave me a recipe for beef in oyster sauce.
senses.example_zh: 我朋友給我一份蠔油牛肉的食譜。

senses.example: I got this recipe from Mr. Green's cookbook.
senses.example_zh: 我從格林先生的烹飪書中找到這個食譜。

senses.example: She received a rejection letter after an interview.
senses.example_zh: 她在面試之後收到一封拒絕信。

senses.example: Massage enhances relaxation of muscles.
senses.example_zh: 按摩促進肌肉放鬆。

senses.example: Hiking and camping are his favorite relaxations.
senses.example_zh: 健行與露營是他最喜歡的休閒活動。

senses.example: I like to listen to the rhythm of the falling rain.
senses.example_zh: 我喜歡聽雨落下的節奏聲。

senses.example: He is making rhythmic tapping sounds with his feet.
senses.example_zh: 他正用腳打拍子。

senses.example: You forgot to put the plug into the socket.
senses.example_zh: 你忘記插插頭了。

senses.example: Sparks flew in every direction.
senses.example_zh: 火花四射。

senses.example: I have been dating him for a month and there is no spark.
senses.example_zh: 我已經跟他約會一個月，但我們之間沒有火花。

senses.example: The device sparked and caught on fire.
senses.example_zh: 這個裝置發出火花然後就著火了。

senses.example: This speech sparked my interest in philosophy.
senses.example_zh: 這場演講激發我對哲學的興趣。

senses.example: The hunters cornered a deer and thrust spears into it.
senses.example_zh: 那些獵人圍住一頭鹿，用長矛刺入牠的身體。

senses.example: The diver speared a fish and grilled it on the shore.
senses.example_zh: 潛水夫叉起一條魚，然後在岸上烤了牠。

senses.example: Mr. Scrooge is a selfish and stingy man.
senses.example_zh: 史古基先生是一個自私又小氣的人。

senses.example: She is stingy with praise.
senses.example_zh: 她吝於讚美別人。

senses.example: The battered woman sued her husband for divorce.
senses.example_zh: 這名受虐婦女對丈夫提告，訴請離婚。

senses.example: Through the telescope, you can see the rings around Saturn.
senses.example_zh: 透過望遠鏡，可以看到環繞土星的光環。

senses.example: Binoculars are a must for bird watching.
senses.example_zh: 雙筒望遠鏡是賞鳥的必備品。

senses.example: Rabbits are timid animals.
senses.example_zh: 兔子是膽小的動物。

senses.example: The Awá tribe of the Amazon tried hard to preserve their tribal cultures.
senses.example_zh: 位於亞馬遜的阿瓦部落致力保存部落文化。

senses.example: She became a troublesome kid roaming on the streets.
senses.example_zh: 她變成一名在街上遊蕩的麻煩小孩。

senses.example: Her son is a troublemaker who gets in a lot of fights.
senses.example_zh: 她兒子是個經常打架的麻煩製造者。

senses.example: You are welcome to visit my website.
senses.example_zh: 歡迎參觀我的網站。

senses.example: A 30-minute workout daily can greatly increase your physical fitness.
senses.example_zh: 每天健身三十分鐘能大幅增進體能。

senses.example: In order to keep fit, I work out three times a week.
senses.example_zh: 我為了維持健康，一星期健身三次。

senses.example: It is not a good idea to bring your pet to your workplace.
senses.example_zh: 帶寵物去上班可不是個好主意。

senses.zh: 將～強加於～【~ A on B】
senses.example: You shouldn't impose your opinions on others.
senses.example_zh: 你不該強迫他人接受你的意見。

senses.zh: 將～強加於～【~ A on B】
senses.example: The government has imposed high taxes on wines and cigarettes.
senses.example_zh: 政府對於酒課以重稅。

senses.zh: 硬給～增加麻煩、打擾【~ on sb.】
senses.example: She is always imposing on people, getting everyone to do things for her.
senses.example_zh: 她總是強迫別人幫她做事。

senses.example: The artworks displayed here are classified into several categories.
senses.example_zh: 這裡展示的藝術品分成好幾類。

senses.example: The characters in a movie are usually categorized into good and bad.
senses.example_zh: 電影裡的角色通常分為好人與壞人。

senses.example: In case it rains hard, you'll need an alternative plan.
senses.example_zh: 萬一下大雨，你要有一個替代方案。

senses.example: Isn't there any alternative to cutting the budget?
senses.example_zh: 除了刪減預算外沒有任何替代方案嗎？

senses.zh: 統計數字（使用複數動詞）
senses.example: Statistics show that more and more teenagers are nearsighted.
senses.example_zh: 統計數字顯示愈來愈多青少年近視。

senses.example: He teaches statistics in university.
senses.example_zh: 他在大學教統計學。

senses.example: Why do tigers have stripes but leopards have spots?
senses.example_zh: 為什麼老虎有條紋而花豹則有斑點呢？

senses.example: You do not seem to put health on the top of your priority list.
senses.example_zh: 你似乎未把健康擺在第一順位。

senses.example: My family is always my priority.
senses.example_zh: 家庭永遠是我的優先考量。

senses.example: Human rights have priority over business interests.
senses.example_zh: 人權比商業利益重要。

senses.example: You should prioritize your goals.
senses.example_zh: 你應該將目標先後排序。

senses.example: Intuition told me to go straight.
senses.example_zh: 直覺告訴我向前直走。

senses.example: Intuitive decisions often result in chaos.
senses.example_zh: 依賴直覺所做的決定常引發混亂。

senses.example: All these years' headache is a terrible torture to me.
senses.example_zh: 多年的頭痛對我而言是個可怕的折磨。

senses.example: The prisoner was tortured to death.
senses.example_zh: 這名犯人遭刑求致死。

senses.zh: 使～痛苦、使～受精神折磨（常用被動）【be ~ed with】
senses.example: He has been tortured with guilt ever since.
senses.example_zh: 他從那時起就一直受到罪惡感的折磨。

senses.example: I can't ensure that you will be safe.
senses.example_zh: 我不能保證你的安全。

senses.example: The job ensures me a fixed income.
senses.example_zh: 這份工作確保我有一份固定的收入。

senses.example: Inflation shrinks the value of money.
senses.example_zh: 通貨膨脹使幣值縮水。

senses.example: You can inflate the balloons with a balloon pump.
senses.example_zh: 你可以用氣球專用的打氣筒將這些氣球充氣。

senses.example: There may be gender differences in attitudes toward work.
senses.example_zh: 工作態度可能存在性別差異。

senses.example: We still have two vacancies for electricians.
senses.example_zh: 我們還有兩個電工的空缺。

senses.example: The sign outside the motel said, "No Vacancies."
senses.example_zh: 汽車旅館外的牌子寫著「客滿」。

senses.example: There is some potential danger involved in the work.
senses.example_zh: 這項工作有潛在的危險。

senses.example: Human potential is unlimited.
senses.example_zh: 人類的潛能無限。

senses.zh: 使～安全、使～牢靠【~ N against / from】
senses.example: We should secure our house against the upcoming typhoon.
senses.example_zh: 我們應保護房子免受颱風來襲的威脅。

senses.example: Do you feel secure about the future?
senses.example_zh: 你對未來感到安心嗎？

senses.example: The treehouse is sturdy and secure.
senses.example_zh: 這座樹屋既牢固又安全。

senses.example: No shop can be completely secure against theft.
senses.example_zh: 沒有商店可以完全防盜。

senses.example: She is very insecure about her appearance.
senses.example_zh: 她對外表缺乏自信。

senses.example: It is normal to feel insecure in a new environment.
senses.example_zh: 在新環境中感到不安是很正常的。

senses.zh: 議題、引發爭論的問題事件
senses.example: We discussed many important issues.
senses.example_zh: 我們討論了許多重要的議題。

senses.example: There is an article on motorbikes in the latest issue.
senses.example_zh: 最新的一期中有篇關於摩托車的文章。

senses.example: The post office issues new stamps every year.
senses.example_zh: 郵局每年都會發行新郵票。

senses.example: The government issued a statement about the bomb blast.
senses.example_zh: 政府針對炸彈爆炸事件發表聲明。

senses.example: Some Muslim countries do not issue visas to missionaries.
senses.example_zh: 有些回教國家不核發簽證給傳教士。

senses.example: Your answer is not relevant to my question at all.
senses.example_zh: 你的答案和我的問題毫不相關。

senses.example: These documents are irrelevant to the present investigation.
senses.example_zh: 這些文件與目前的偵查無關。

senses.example: Your question has no relevance to the issue.
senses.example_zh: 你的問題與這個議題無關。

senses.example: It is an authentic autograph of the famous basketball player.
senses.example_zh: 這是那位著名籃球選手的親筆簽名。

senses.example: The restaurant sells authentic French food.
senses.example_zh: 這間餐廳賣道地的法國菜。

senses.zh: 語意含糊的、模稜兩可的
senses.example: Politicians are good at making ambiguous remarks.
senses.example_zh: 政客擅長發表模稜兩可的言論。

senses.example: The teacher drew a diagram of a leaf and its vessels.
senses.example_zh: 老師畫了一張樹葉與葉脈的圖解。

senses.example: The graph shows the distribution of population in our country.
senses.example_zh: 這張圖表顯示我國的人口分布。

senses.zh: 以線型圖說明、畫出線型圖
senses.example: Researchers graphed the data to make us better understand.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員將資料畫成線型圖，幫助我們更加了解。

senses.example: New York is a very culturally diverse city.
senses.example_zh: 紐約是個文化多元的城市。

senses.example: Taipei is a city of great diversity.
senses.example_zh: 臺北是一座多元化的城市。

senses.example: The students are from a variety of ethnic backgrounds.
senses.example_zh: 這些學生來自不同民族背景。

senses.example: Special laws are enforced to protect the rights of ethnic minorities.
senses.example_zh: 為了保障少數民族的權益實施專法。

senses.example: I returned the book and got a refund.
senses.example_zh: 我退回書本並收到退款。

senses.example: We promise to refund the customer in full.
senses.example_zh: 我們允諾將全額退費給這位顧客。

senses.example: My nephew is a complete video game addict.
senses.example_zh: 我外甥是名十足的電玩迷。

senses.zh: 使～上癮【常用被動 be ~ed to N】
senses.example: The young man is addicted to drugs.
senses.example_zh: 這個年輕人有毒癮。

senses.example: I am addicted to chocolate.
senses.example_zh: 我超愛吃巧克力。

senses.example: We appreciate your feedback regarding our services.
senses.example_zh: 感謝您對我們的服務給予意見回饋。

senses.example: Be careful with that vase—it is very fragile.
senses.example_zh: 小心那個花瓶，它很容易破。

senses.example: The thin girl looks fragile, but in fact she is very strong.
senses.example_zh: 這個單薄的女孩看起來虛弱，實際上力氣很大。

senses.example: There are many options to choose from.
senses.example_zh: 有許多選項可供選擇。

senses.example: Communities have a clear responsibility to help people with disability.
senses.example_zh: 社區對於協助殘障人士責無旁貸。

senses.example: What are the most nutritious fruits and vegetables?
senses.example_zh: 最有營養的蔬菜水果有哪些？
